verdict.rationale: Perplexity's Search API docs say it returns ranked web results "with controls for domains, languages, regions," so language and region localization is a first-party capability. This rests on a single summary line, so its depth is unproven. Missing for 10: named country/language/location request parameters and their accepted values, finer-grained location targeting (city or coordinates), whether localization applies to the Sonar/Agent answer endpoints and not just raw Search, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can localize results by country, language, or location parameters

citations.quote: Perplexity's Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data, with controls for domains, languages, regions, and extracted content.
